chunks: Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Zaid ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) told us in Qom in Rajab, the year 339, that he said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim informed me, in the year 307, that he said: My father told me, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) forbade me – and I will not say that he forbade you – from wearing rings of gold, wearing clothes of qisi, wearing purple pads, wearing red covers, and from reciting while I am kneeling.

key_terms.الْمِيَاثِرُ الْأَرْجُوَانُ: Purple pads (used for sitting or prayer)
key_terms.ثِيَابُ الْقِسِيِّ: Clothes made of qisi (a type of silk or fine fabric)
key_terms.رَاكِعٌ: Kneeling (in the state of ruku' during prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet forbid Imam Ali regarding clothing and prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* highlights the Prophet’s specific prohibitions on luxury and distraction during prayer, including gold rings, *qisi* (silk), purple garments, and reciting Quran while bowing. In Shia jurisprudence, these rulings underscore the distinction between permissible adornment and ostentatious wealth, while emphasizing the reverence required for the Quranic recitation within the physical acts of prayer.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hamza bin Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Ja’far bin Muhammed bin Zaid bin Ali bin Hussain bin Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them, in Qom, in Rajab, year 339, that he said: I was informed by Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, year 307, that he said: I was told by my father, from Muhammed bin Abi ‘Umayr, from Hammad bin Uthman, from Abdullah bin Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said: Ali, peace be upon him, said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, forbade me – and I will not say that he forbade you – from wearing rings of gold, the clothes of the qisi, pads in purple, covers in red and from reciting while I am kneeling.
